title: Covered Openings and Service Address Limits, CareLine Service Plans
content:
A CareLine Service Plans plan covers a set number of window openings and door units at one home. The plan fee covers a base count of openings; a plan can never cover more than its maximum; and where a tier offers openings above its base count, each one carries a yearly extra-opening fee.

### Plan comparison: openings

| Tier | Openings covered by the plan fee (base count) | Most openings the plan can cover | Yearly fee per covered opening above the base count (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 15 | 15 | 0.00 |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 25 | 25 | 0.00 |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 30 | 30 | 0.00 |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 30 | 30 | 0.00 |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 40 | 60 | 4.00 |

A yearly fee of 0.00 marks a tier on which openings above the base count are not offered: on every tier other than the CareLine Estate Plan the base count and the maximum are the same figure. On the CareLine Estate Plan openings 41 through 60 can be added, each at 4.00 per plan year.

**Enrolment limit.** Each CareLine plan (Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year and Estate) can be opened only for a home whose openings are at most the plan's maximum, and only for the service address. The On-Call Service Account is opened for the service address and carries no annual fee; its plan fee covers no openings.

**Mid-term changes in covered openings.** On every tier, a mid-term change in covered openings is billed by prorating the yearly extra-opening fee over the full months remaining in the plan year.

### Plan comparison: the covered home

| Tier | Which home the plan covers | Largest distance of the service address from the nearest Ridgeline branch |
|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | The service address only | 60 miles |
| CareLine Basic Plan | The service address only | 60 miles |
| CareLine Plus Plan | The service address only | 60 miles |
| CareLine Premier Plan | The service address only | 60 miles |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | The service address only | 60 miles |
| CareLine Estate Plan | The service address only | 60 miles |

Every account and plan covers the service address only, and that address must lie no more than 60 miles from the nearest Ridgeline branch.

### Selection cases (hypothetical homes)

| Hypothetical home | CareLine Plus Plan (maximum 25) | CareLine Estate Plan (base 40, maximum 60) |
|---|---|---|
| 22 openings and door units | Within the maximum | Within the base count; no extra-opening fee |
| 25 openings and door units | Within the maximum (equal to it) | Within the base count; no extra-opening fee |
| 26 openings and door units | Above the maximum; cannot be covered | Within the base count; no extra-opening fee |
| 44 openings and door units | Above the maximum | 4 openings above the base count, each at 4.00 per plan year |
| 61 openings and door units | Above the maximum | Above the maximum of 60; cannot be covered |

A hypothetical service address 60 miles from the nearest Ridgeline branch lies within the radius; one 61 miles away does not.
